title: 80 Million Trees Flattened in One Second
description: The Tunguska event of 1908: a massive blast in Siberia, and no crater.

scenes.narration: Eighty million trees, knocked flat in a single instant. And no crater.
scenes.image_prompt: vast Siberian forest with millions of trees knocked flat in a radial pattern, aerial view

scenes.narration: It's the morning of June 30th, 1908, in remote Siberia, near the Tunguska River.
scenes.image_prompt: quiet Siberian taiga forest and river at dawn, mist, 1908

scenes.narration: A fireball streaks across the sky, brighter than the sun.
scenes.image_prompt: blinding fireball streaking across the sky over the Siberian forest, long smoke trail

scenes.narration: It explodes in the air, several kilometres above the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: giant airburst explosion flash above a forest, shockwave visible in the sky

scenes.narration: The blast flattens about two thousand square kilometres of forest.
scenes.image_prompt: shockwave blowing down trees across a huge forest, dust and debris

scenes.narration: Sixty kilometres away, a man is thrown from his chair, and his shirt feels like it's on fire.
scenes.image_prompt: Russian man on a wooden trading post porch thrown backwards by a blast of heat and wind, 1908

scenes.narration: Scientists think a space rock burst before it reached the ground.
scenes.image_prompt: asteroid entering Earth's atmosphere glowing orange, view from space

scenes.narration: If something like it hit a city today, the damage would be enormous. What do you think it was? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: scientists in 1920s clothing walking through fallen scorched trees in Siberia
